title: I spent 3 months building my first mobile game solo with Claude – Carat is now in beta on Android, I'd love your feedback!
author: Aflowstudio
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev!

For the past 3 months I've been building Carat: Merge Gems & Decorate on my own, with Claude writing the code alongside me.

It's a physics-based gem merge puzzle game: you drop gems that combine into rarer stones, all the way up to the black diamond. There are 4 different puzzle modes with quick 3-minute rounds, and you use your earnings to decorate a 3D luxury villa (600+ furniture pieces). There's a light heist theme to tie it all together.

It just launched in beta on the Play Store and I'd love honest feedback:

\- Is the merge gameplay satisfying? Does it hook you in the first minute?

\- Which of the 4 modes do you prefer?

\- Anything confusing or buggy?

How I made it:

\- Code: Claude

\- Hardest parts:

  \- Getting the game balance right (merge rates, rewards, difficulty)

  \- Making 3D models that actually look good

  \- Animating some of the 3D models, which was by far the trickiest part

Happy to answer any questions about the process!

👉 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aflowstudio.carat

Thanks for checking it out 🙏
